title: Independently verify PR5413 neutrality, necessary pricing and source application
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Retain and reproduce the independent literal-invoice, signed-neutrality and two-point necessary-price review for [PR5413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413), exact `0c1fa2f47fb5ea17b93a4b67063d08e49cc38e51`, together with the separately written conditional source-application audit. This is one focused verification companion to the primary `research/coupled-helper-neutral-completion` construction.

The independent screen alone establishes necessary gates. The separate written audit accepts the frozen complete conjunction under the same five selected assumptions, with 15 structured obligation rows, 25 aggregate named premises and 58 outer guards. Primary proposed κ is `.003027288235`, tested at `.003027288245`; its `5e−12` comparison improvement is compiler/outer certificate headroom. Equal additions of 144 paid H8 and 144 target H8 preserve the raw signed profile and raw ceiling, with **zero recursive economic gain**. This companion adds no κ gain or construction, and selected `.0030217758` remains unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Catalogue `independent-moment`, priority revision 7, `scope_status: changed` for the explicitly assigned verification task. Canonical base `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`. The primary construction and [public independent source review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413#issuecomment-6378601294) remain the canonical construction/audit links. PR5409 separately provides the fixed old-family ceiling; this companion does not duplicate either construction or ceiling.

Portable raw Git commit/tree/blob origins authenticate exact primary source-binding/claims metadata, canonical provenance and the older #5398 source inputs. All 20 final reviewed input hashes and lengths were directly compared with original public PR5413 Git bytes. The independent checker and all consumed inputs, written source audit, corrected/rejected/pending snapshots and existing execution/publication evidence are self-contained. No fork-only Git-history dependency is required at replay time.

## Validation

The independent checker binds 18 backward LOCAL calls, 15 QUERY shears, 15 retained whole idles and 114 main events, complete aliases/owners, 32 Gaussian rows and both histograms: 64,260 paid / 10,928 productive fields, masses 238,990 / 239,742, surplus 752. Exact signed coefficients establish all-real-exponent neutrality; three H8 fault controls reject. At `.003027288245`, target minus paid is strictly between `0.000001218925797781515135188889161250` and `0.000001218925797781515135188889161251`. Fresh neutral `1−P/T` is strictly between `0.000000000005139408826607231162854402` and `0.000000000005139408826607231162854403`; both reserve `1e−12` and separately typed outer-r0 `1/7000000000000` pass their necessary alpha gates. At `.00302728825`, raw and positive-rho tests reject. The display bounds are rationals over 10^36; original integer/2^256 and exact Fraction endpoints remain retained.

The written source audit separately checks the corrected 145-axis caller/coordinate plan, actual native translations, 18×649 concrete invocation join, all helpers/targets, complete ordinary and whole-SWAP charges, fresh F16/error/stock/tape/source specialization and 54 strict plus four functional outer guards. Existing primary component, precision, funding and 25-premise aggregate receipts are authenticated reuse. Their engines are not imported or rerun by this companion. Earlier pending/rejected snapshots remain unchanged and clearly historical.

The new registered wrapper authenticates the complete frozen packet, exact source origins and 20-input public join; it runs only the tiny independent screen, compares every scientific field, preserves fresh raw receipts/stdout/stderr, and requires all pre/post package bytes unchanged. Normal/O acceptance uses explicit predicates, changed-byte and forged-origin controls, and private bytecode-cache namespaces. The exact guarded run, source/history/export and readonly Git-free outcomes are recorded in the final handoff; no unrecorded execution is inferred here. Primary hosted CI success is retained as root-verified publication evidence, separate from theorem proof. The exact sealed companion commit is `bc37fb01c58d20e799d3299dec63e654f67d9d1b` (144 files). The shared serial guard records registered normal/O PASS in 1.814606 seconds, readonly Git-free normal PASS in 0.604644 seconds and optimized PASS in 0.805985 seconds, each under 30 seconds/256 MiB. Exactly four tiny independent-screen invocations ran; no other scientific engine was executed. Every fresh scientific field matches the original independent root receipt, excluding only environment. All 144 working files and all 145 extracted files (including transport receipt) remain unchanged; the export is 0444, has no `.git`, and both direct commands ran with empty PATH and absolute interpreter. Final metadata, committed-byte/canonical-source-history and official export integrity checks pass. Export SHA256 `c9329642b9817dee293ed1a6a6229bb032b7f97e1a8f249b0e4a7c8e5d422cd7` (9,175,040 bytes). Independent static publication review passes; it is separate from human or theorem acceptance. The primary did not test empty PATH; any companion portability test is separately scoped.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/neutral632-independent-verification
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/neutral632-independent-verification --check-source-history
```

Git-free direct commands are `python3 -I -B research/neutral632-independent-verification/verify.py` and its `-O` variant; `--integrity-only` authenticates without numerical execution. No original/native/provider/precision/funding/aggregate/primary or cold replay is performed. Independent human approval, formal-kernel acceptance, physical tape execution, unconditional multiplication and maintainer selection remain unclaimed.

## Credit

Preserve Dillon (@dillona) / PR5402's unrestricted provider; Ali Romman's cached-center/#5398 controller and source certificates; Cao Yifan's native source; Cinna Davis's controller/helpers; zxv's physical/compiler/precision/higher-moment lineage; Jacob Alan Sussman's integer flow; Chris R's source/phase/component/caller reviews; Dugongue and every retained Clifford/BIT/analytic/recovery contributor and notice. Independent numerical verification, written source-application review and companion packaging by **Chris R / Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**; Apache-2.0. Root performed the original guarded executions. No new construction priority or human acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

Independent human or formal review can inspect the written F16/error/stock/source-class application. A genuine recursive improvement requires a changed signed profile or mechanism and its complete bill, rather than neutral H8 additions or extra raw-root digits. Hosted CI, substantive maintainer review and selection remain separate. `TASK.json` records relevance, first steps and blockers for each question.

### Scientific handoff

HANDOFF

**Research discussion / PR / artifact:** Focused companion `research/neutral632-independent-verification` to [primary PR5413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413), exact head `0c1fa2f47fb5ea17b93a4b67063d08e49cc38e51`. [Public independent source review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413#issuecomment-6378601294). Local packet `outputs/neutral632-verification-package-20261024`; root owns companion publication, exact-head readback and hosted status.

**Exact commit:** `bc37fb01c58d20e799d3299dec63e654f67d9d1b`, branch `research/neutral632-independent-verification`, direct canonical parent `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`. Nineteen raw Git commit/tree/blob proofs authenticate primary, canonical and old #5398 provenance. All 20 final reviewed source digests and lengths match public primary Git bytes. Export SHA256 `c9329642b9817dee293ed1a6a6229bb032b7f97e1a8f249b0e4a7c8e5d422cd7`, 9,175,040 bytes / 144 package files. Final metadata, committed-byte/canonical-source-history and official export checks pass; working tree is clean.

**What is established:** The independent screen binds 18 backward LOCAL calls, 15 QUERY shears, 15 whole idles, 114 main events, every literal alias/owner and 32 Gaussian rows. It reconstructs 64,260 paid / 10,928 productive fields, masses 238,990 / 239,742 and surplus 752. Equal additions of 144 H8 jobs preserve the signed raw moment at every real exponent with zero recursive economic gain; three neutrality fault controls reject. Fresh neutral alpha passes the two necessary screens at .003027288245 and rejects .00302728825. This numerical result supplies necessary gates only. The separate written source review accepts conditional κ=.003027288235 under the same five assumptions, with 15 structured obligation rows, 25 aggregate named premises and 58 outer guards. It reviews the corrected 145-axis caller, actual 649-field invocation joins, ordinary/precision/F16/stock/source arguments and existing exact execution evidence. The primary's 5e−12 comparison gain is compiler/outer headroom. The independent static publication audit passes. All four authorized tiny-screen executions passed through the shared guard: registered normal/O pair 1.814606 seconds, readonly Git-free normal 0.604644 seconds and optimized 0.805985 seconds. All scientific fields match the original root receipt except environment; all 144 package files and 145 extracted files remain unchanged. Fresh raw receipts, child stdout/stderr and actual pre/post inventories are preserved.

**What remains uncertain:** Necessary signs alone do not provide complete κ admission. The written application retains `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`. No human/kernel/unconditional acceptance, physical tape execution or selected-record change is claimed. Earlier rejected/pending snapshots remain immutable history; the named final report and replay evidence resolve only their stated obligations. Root-verified primary CI success is publication evidence, separate from theorem proof. Primary empty-PATH execution remains untested; this companion's successful readonly/empty-PATH tests do not transfer that coverage to the primary.

**Smallest useful next task:** Root reviews the sealed package, independent static audit and transport receipts, then publishes one companion PR and records its exact head and CI separately. Stop this support task here. The user's new κ≥.0033 direction requires a separately changed mechanism or signed profile with its complete bill; this packet justifies no additional endpoint digits or duplicate primary replay. Human/formal review of the retained F16/error/stock/source specialization is a separate option.

**Reproduction command and expected runtime:** `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/neutral632-independent-verification` runs only the tiny independent screen in normal/O modes; the guarded pair took 1.815 seconds under 30 seconds / 256 MiB. `python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/neutral632-independent-verification --check-source-history` checks transport and declared canonical provenance. Git-free direct command: `/usr/bin/python3 -I -B research/neutral632-independent-verification/verify.py`; add `-O` for optimized mode. Recorded direct times are 0.605 / 0.806 seconds with empty PATH, every file 0444 and no `.git`. `--integrity-only` authenticates without numerical execution. Exact argv, guard and log hashes, four fresh scientific receipts and custody records are in `RUNREQUESTS.json`, `RUN-RESULTS.json`, `runs/` and `fresh/`. No native/provider/precision/funding/aggregate/primary/cold engine was imported or replayed.
